jackery.title: Sign in to Jackery
jackery.description: Your credentials are used only to retrieve the Bluetooth key and are not stored. Email accounts require the two-letter region selected in the Jackery app.

data.region: Account region e.g. DE or US (email only)

data_description.login_method: Choose the same login method used in the Jackery app.
data_description.account: Enter the email address or telephone number of your Jackery account.
data_description.password: Used during setup to retrieve the Bluetooth key. It is not saved.
data_description.region: Required only for email login. Use the two-letter country code configured in the Jackery app, such as DE or US.

shelly_bridge.title: Add local Shelly Pro 3EM <-> HomeWizard P1 bridge
shelly_bridge.description: This exposes one Shelly Pro 3EM as a HomeWizard P1 meter. Use standard HTTP port 80 for Jackery compatibility. The advertised address must be the Home Assistant host's LAN IPv4 address reachable by the SolarVault.

data.shelly_host: Shelly hostname, IP, or base URL

data_description.shelly_host: The Shelly's local address, for example 192.168.1.50 or {local_url}. Cloud URLs are not supported.
data_description.bridge_serial: A stable virtual HomeWizard identity. Keep the generated value unless it conflicts with another bridge.
data_description.bridge_port: The TCP port served by Home Assistant. Use port 80; a non-standard port may be discovered but reported offline by the SolarVault.
data_description.advertise_address: The LAN IPv4 address of the Home Assistant machine, not the Shelly address. The SolarVault must be able to reach it.
data_description.shelly_authentication: Leave disabled for a passwordless Shelly. Enable it only if local web/RPC authentication is configured on the Shelly.
data_description.shelly_username: Used only when authentication is enabled. Shelly Gen2 devices normally use admin.
data_description.shelly_password: Used only when authentication is enabled. It will be stored in Home Assistant's config-entry storage.
data_description.invert_power: Enable if imported grid power appears negative instead of positive. CT clamp orientation is preferably corrected at the meter.

jackery_3p_bridge.title: Add experimental Jackery Smart Meter 3P discovery mock
jackery_3p_bridge.description: Discovery only: the service may be visible on the LAN, but app recognition, binding, and live metering are unverified. The Jackery app may require a cloud registered accessory identity. Use the Home Assistant host's reachable LAN IPv4 address and port 80. The serial and bind key are provisional until compared with a physical 3P.

data.shelly_host: Shelly hostname, IP, or base URL
data.bridge_serial: Provisional 3P serial (6 to 24 letters or digits)

data_description.shelly_host: The Shelly's local address, for example 192.168.1.50 or {local_url}.
data_description.bridge_serial: A virtual serial used in the experimental DNS-SD instance name.
data_description.jackery_3p_bind_key: A hexadecimal number from 00000000 to 7FFFFFFF. The app parses it as a signed 32-bit integer. This provisional value is advertised; do not use an account or device secret.
data_description.bridge_port: The local listener port; port 80 is the current research target.
data_description.advertise_address: The LAN IPv4 address of the Home Assistant machine.
data_description.shelly_authentication: Enable only if local RPC authentication is configured on the Shelly.
data_description.shelly_username: Usually admin for Shelly Gen2 devices.
data_description.shelly_password: Stored in Home Assistant config-entry storage.
